articles.summary: Recombinant proteins represent a cornerstone of modern biotechnology, playing pivotal roles across medical, industrial, and research sectors. These proteins, meticulously engineered through genetic manipulation, offer tailored functionalities ranging from therapeutics to industrial enzymes and research tools.
